name: origin-physical-ai
description: Origin Physical AI — the robot-readiness + agent-autonomy + RL-environment monorepo (Console, Janus, Cobra, Chronos, Factory).
comment:workspaces: chronos-ui is React 18 and is installed STANDALONE (its own node_modules) so its types don't collide with the React 19 apps under npm hoisting. The Makefile builds it separately. Switch to pnpm later for true isolation (see docs/MIGRATION.md).

scripts.build:chronos-ui: npm --prefix apps/chronos-ui install && npm --prefix apps/chronos-ui run build

comment:overrides: @insforge/shared-schemas (via @insforge/sdk) still declares zod ^3, and every zod below 4.6.6 carries GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (zod 3 has no patch). The SDK never parses with zod; it reads two enum values, identical under zod 4. Cost: its zod-3 .d.ts types degrade under zod 4 (skipLibCheck hides it): two auth calls and the OAuth provider type in apps/origin-web/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx, and user/id/email typing in 6 edge functions under apps/origin-web/functions. Redo the never-parses check on every @insforge/sdk bump; drop this once shared-schemas depends on zod >=4.6.6. Detail: PR #103.
